# Overview of the Evaluation Architecture

**`scSimEval`** evaluates single-cell and multiomics simulation methods using an empirical reference benchmarking framework organized into **56 evaluation measures across 8 canonical categories**.

Every measure operates directly on empirical biological reference data and synthetic count matrices generated by simulators across **scRNA-seq**, **scATAC-seq**, and **multiomics (scRNA-seq + scATAC-seq)** layers, using normalized expressions, clustering structures, biological replicate annotations, and profiling metadata.

---

# Summary Table of the 8 Categories

| Category | Domain | Measures | Modality Scope | Primary Focus |
|:---:|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
| **I** | **Distributional Properties** | **14** | Shared (scRNA + scATAC) | 10 univariate (1D) and 4 bivariate (2D) statistical distances across 7 cell-level, 7 feature-level, and 4 bivariate property pairs |
| **II** | **Sparsity & Zero-Inflation Dynamics** | **5** | Shared / Modality-Specific | Logistic dropout kinetics (scRNA), quadratic accessibility-sparsity curves (scATAC), and NB excess zero weights (Shared) |
| **III** | **Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance** | **8** | Shared (scRNA + scATAC) | Latent manifold RKHS divergence & support (MMD, Precision, Recall) + clustering quality & concordance (ASW, CDI, Purity, ARI, NMI) |
| **IV** | **Technical Variation & Batch Mixing Dynamics** | **5** | Shared (scRNA + scATAC) | Technical confounder mixing and cross-batch biological transfer (Batch Silhouette, PCR $R^2$, CMS, ISI, Cross-Batch F1) |
| **V** | **Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity** | **12** | scRNA-seq DE (6) & scATAC-seq DA (6) | Pseudobulk `edgeR`-QLF differential recovery (Null P-value uniformity, Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1-score, ROC-AUC) |
| **VI** | **Multiomics Integration & Alignment** | **5** | Multiomics (Joint Latent Space) | Batch ASW, Cell-Type ASW, k-NN Graph Connectivity, Integration ARI, and Integration NMI |
| **VII** | **Trajectory & Lineage Topology** | **5** | scRNA-seq | HVG-filtered *dynverse* benchmark (Saelens et al., 2019): HIM & edge-flip topology similarity, geodesic distance correlation, branch assignment F1, and Random Forest `wcor_features` |
| **VIII** | **Computational Scalability & Efficiency** | **2** | Computation / Shared | Core-Seconds ($\text{Elapsed Time} \times N_{\text{cores}}$; Lannelongue et al., 2021) and Peak RAM per allocated core ($\text{Peak RAM} / N_{\text{cores}}$, MiB/core or GiB/core; Holtgrewe et al., 2015; Boisvert et al., 2012) |
| **Total** | | **56** | **Full Benchmark Suite** | **Comprehensive single-cell & multiomics evaluation framework** |

---

# Complete Master Reference Table (56 Measures)

| # | Metric ID | Display Label | Category | Direction | Biological & Mathematical Scope |
|:--:|:---|:---|:---|:---:|:---|
| 1 | `Wasserstein` | Wasserstein Dist. | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | 1D Earth Mover's Distance ($W_1$) across 14 univariate cell/feature properties |
| 2 | `KS` | KS Distance | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | Kolmogorov-Smirnov supremum ECDF distance across 14 univariate properties |
| 3 | `MAD` | MAD | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | Median Absolute Quantile Deviation across 14 univariate properties |
| 4 | `MAE` | MAE | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | Mean Absolute Quantile Error across 14 univariate properties |
| 5 | `RMSE` | RMSE | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | Root Mean Squared Quantile Error emphasizing tail alignment |
| 6 | `Bhattacharyya` | Bhattacharyya Dist. | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | Information-theoretic divergence between discrete probability distributions |
| 7 | `KDE_ISE` | KDE ISE | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | 1D Kernel Density Integrated Squared Error ($L_2$ density distance) |
| 8 | `Runs_Statistic` | Runs Statistic | (I) Distributional Properties | Closer to 0 | Standardized Wald-Wolfowitz runs statistic ($Z_{\text{runs}}$) testing mixing |
| 9 | `NN_Mismatch` | NN Mismatch | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | 1D nearest-neighbor dataset mismatch fraction ($p_{\chi^2} \le 0.05$) |
| 10 | `Between_Dataset_Silh_Global` | Inter-Dataset Silhouette | (I) Distributional Properties | Closer to 0 | 1D global inter-dataset silhouette width (reference vs. simulated) |
| 11 | `Fasano_Franceschini_2D_KS` | Fasano-Franceschini 2D | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | 2D Kolmogorov-Smirnov discrepancy across 4 bivariate property pairs |
| 12 | `EMD_2D` | 2D EMD | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | 2D Earth Mover's Distance between $25\times 25$ bivariate KDE surfaces |
| 13 | `NN_Mismatch_2D` | 2D NN Mismatch | (I) Distributional Properties | Lower is better | 2D z-standardized nearest-neighbor dataset mismatch fraction |
| 14 | `Between_Dataset_Silh_2D_Global` | 2D Inter-Dataset Silhouette | (I) Distributional Properties | Closer to 0 | 2D global inter-dataset silhouette width across bivariate pairs |
| 15 | `midpoint_error` | Dropout Midpoint Error | (II) Sparsity & Zero-Inflation Dynamics | Lower is better | Shift in logistic dropout inflection threshold $x_0$ (scRNA-seq) |
| 16 | `slope_error` | Dropout Slope Error | (II) Sparsity & Zero-Inflation Dynamics | Lower is better | Discrepancy in logistic dropout decay steepness $\beta_1$ (scRNA-seq) |
| 17 | `r2_discrepancy` | Sparsity R2 Discrepancy | (II) Sparsity & Zero-Inflation Dynamics | Lower is better | Difference in sparsity curve $R^2$ (logistic for scRNA, quadratic for scATAC) |
| 18 | `curve_rmse` | Accessibility Sparsity RMSE | (II) Sparsity & Zero-Inflation Dynamics | Lower is better | Quadratic polynomial RMSE relating peak mean accessibility to NZP (scATAC-seq) |
| 19 | `excess_zero_weight_discrepancy` | Excess Zero Weight Discrepancy | (II) Sparsity & Zero-Inflation Dynamics | Lower is better | Difference in posterior technical excess-zero weight beyond NB expectation |
| 20 | `MMD` | MMD | (III) Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance | Lower is better | Multi-scale RBF Maximum Mean Discrepancy in top 50 shared PCs |
| 21 | `Generative_Precision` | Generative Precision | (III) Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance | Higher is better | Fraction of simulated cells inside reference $k$-NN manifold support |
| 22 | `Generative_Recall` | Generative Recall | (III) Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance | Higher is better | Fraction of reference cells covered by simulated $k$-NN support |
| 23 | `silhouette_sim` | Silhouette ASW | (III) Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance | Higher is better | Average Silhouette Width across cell types in 30 PCs |
| 24 | `cdi` | Clustering Deviation Index | (III) Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance | Lower is better | Penalized Negative Binomial log-likelihood $\text{CDI}_{\text{AIC}}$ |
| 25 | `neighborhood_purity` | Neighborhood Purity | (III) Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance | Higher is better | Mean fraction of $k$-nearest neighbors sharing the same cell type |
| 26 | `ari` | ARI | (III) Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance | Higher is better | Adjusted Rand Index between $k$-means clusters and ground-truth cell types |
| 27 | `nmi` | NMI | (III) Cellular Manifold & Clustering Concordance | Higher is better | Normalized Mutual Information between $k$-means clusters and cell types |
| 28 | `batch_silhouette` | Batch Silhouette | (IV) Technical Variation & Batch Mixing Dynamics | Lower (mixed) | Batch separation silhouette width across 30 PCs |
| 29 | `pcr_r2` | PC Regression R2 | (IV) Technical Variation & Batch Mixing Dynamics | Lower is better | Variance-weighted $R^2$ linearly explained by technical batch covariates |
| 30 | `cms` | CMS Score | (IV) Technical Variation & Batch Mixing Dynamics | Higher is better | Cell-Specific Mixing Score (Anderson-Darling $P$-value across local batches) |
| 31 | `isi` | LISI / ISI | (IV) Technical Variation & Batch Mixing Dynamics | Higher is better | Inverse-distance weighted Inverse Simpson Index across local batches |
| 32 | `cross_batch_F1` | Cross-Batch F1 | (IV) Technical Variation & Batch Mixing Dynamics | Higher is better | Directed cross-batch $k$-NN cell-type classification Macro-F1 |
| 33 & 34 | `pval_dist_score` | Null P-Value Uniformity | (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity | Higher is better | $1 - D_{\text{KS}}$ calibration of null raw $P$-values against $\text{Uniform}(0,1)$ (scRNA DE & scATAC DA) |
| 35 & 36 | `accuracy` | DE/DA Accuracy | (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity | Higher is better | Overall DEG/DAR binary classification concordance (scRNA DE & scATAC DA) |
| 37 & 38 | `precision` | DE/DA Precision | (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity | Higher is better | Positive predictive value of simulated differential calls (scRNA DE & scATAC DA) |
| 39 & 40 | `recall` | DE/DA Recall | (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity | Higher is better | Sensitivity recovering ground-truth reference DEGs/DARs (scRNA DE & scATAC DA) |
| 41 & 42 | `f1_score` | DE/DA F1-Score | (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity | Higher is better | Harmonic mean of differential precision and recall (scRNA DE & scATAC DA) |
| 43 & 44 | `auc` | DE/DA ROC-AUC | (V) Biological Signal & Differential Fidelity | Higher is better | Tie-averaged ROC-AUC ranking true DEGs/DARs by $-\log_{10} P_{\text{sim}}$ (scRNA DE & scATAC DA) |
| 45 | `batch_asw` | Batch ASW | (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment | Higher is better | Within-cell-type batch/modality mixing silhouette ($1 - |s_{\text{batch}}|$) |
| 46 | `cell_type_asw` | Cell-Type ASW | (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment | Higher is better | Scaled cell-type silhouette conservation $\frac{1}{2}(\text{ASW} + 1)$ |
| 47 | `graph_connectivity` | Graph Connectivity | (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment | Higher is better | Mean largest connected component fraction per cell type in 15-NN graph |
| 48 | `ari` | Integration ARI | (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment | Higher is better | Truncated ARI between joint-embedding clusters and true cell types |
| 49 | `nmi` | Integration NMI | (VI) Multiomics Integration & Alignment | Higher is better | Entropy-normalized mutual information in joint multiomics embedding |
| 50 | `him` | HIM Topology Sim. | (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology | Higher is better | Hamming-Ipsen-Mikhailov local + Laplacian spectral topology similarity between HVG-inferred milestone networks |
| 51 | `edge_flip` | Edge Flip Sim. | (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology | Higher is better | Minimum normalized edge-flip edit similarity between reference and simulated MST milestone graphs |
| 52 | `geodesic_correlation` | Geodesic Distance Corr. | (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology | Higher is better | Spearman correlation of pairwise cell-to-milestone geodesic distances across shared HVG PCA landmarks |
| 53 | `F1_branches` | Branch Assignment F1 | (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology | Higher is better | Harmonic-mean Jaccard F1 overlap across cellular MST branch assignments (`dyneval` branch concordance) |
| 54 | `wcor_features` | Feature Imp. wCor | (VII) Trajectory & Lineage Topology | Higher is better | Reference-weighted Pearson correlation of `ranger` RF (10,000 trees, `mtry = 1%`) milestone geodesic feature importances |
| 55 | `core_seconds` | Core-Seconds (core·s) | (VIII) Computational Scalability & Efficiency | Lower is better | Total cumulative CPU work across threads: $\text{Elapsed Time (s)} \times N_{\text{cores}}$ (Lannelongue et al., 2021; Wratten et al., 2021; Grealey et al., 2022) |
| 56 | `memory_per_core_mib` | Peak RAM / Core (MiB/core) | (VIII) Computational Scalability & Efficiency | Lower is better | Peak resident memory footprint per allocated core: $\text{Peak RAM (MiB)} / N_{\text{cores}}$ (Holtgrewe et al., 2015; Boisvert et al., 2012; Chen et al., 2022) |

# Category I: 18 Evaluated Distributional Properties

`scSimEval` extracts **7 cell-level properties**, **7 feature-level properties**, and **4 bivariate property pairs**:

- **Cell-level (7):** `library_size`, `log_library_size`, `tmm_factor` (scRNA-seq only; omitted for scATAC-seq), `zero_fraction_cell`, `detection_freq_cell`, `cell_cor`, `pca_dist`.
- **Feature-level (7):** `mean_expression`, `variance`, `scaled_variance`, `cv`, `zero_fraction_feature`, `dispersion`, `gene_cor`.
- **Bivariate pairs (4):** `lib_vs_cellzero`, `mean_vs_sd`, `mean_vs_featzero`, `mean_vs_dispersion`.
